headline.applicable_mersen_condition: 890 VDC, L/R <= 2.5 ms, for capacitor discharge applications (A70QS French Cylindrical, PDF p.20 / HS 20)
headline.time_constant_definition: L/R (the catalogue's own definition), NOT R*C

time_constant_reconciliation.basis: '*Time Constant: L/R <=1ms' in the catalogue's DC tables (p.3/HS2, p.7/HS6); the A70QS page uses 'L/R <=10ms' and '10ms time constant' interchangeably
time_constant_reconciliation.applicable_capacitor_discharge_figure: 890 VDC up to 2.5 ms time constant (PDF p.20), explicitly scoped to capacitor discharge
time_constant_reconciliation.general_dc_figure_not_applicable: 700 VDC / L/R <= 10 ms (same page) is the general DC-protection rating, not the capacitor-discharge condition

rc_rejected.note: AR-COORD's 714x factor corresponds to 2L/R : R*C; L/R : R*C is 357x. Either way R*C is not the manufacturer's time constant and the heavily underdamped zeta shows an RC decay does not describe the waveform.

time_constant_reconciliation.withdrawn: the R*C <= 1.43 ms comparison against the 2.5 ms figure (AR-COORD)

joint_mapping.rule: cell qualifies iff (pre-arcing ACTION screen met) AND (L/R <= 2.5 ms) AND (V <= 890 V) AND (peak <= 100 kA)

action_screen.kind: pre-arcing ACTION screen, not a melting result

current.caveat: 100 kA is the general DC I.R. at L/R = 11.6 ms; no cap-discharge-specific peak limit is published

joint_mapping.region_expression: {400*L <= R <= 0.64013 ohm}; R in [5 mOhm, 0.5 ohm], L in [20 nH, 20 uH]

applicable_clearing_data.what_would_resolve: a DC / capacitor-discharge let-through (total clearing I2t) curve for A70QS50-14F at the 890 VDC condition, plus a sourced bank/PCB-copper withstand I2t to compare against

oracle_scope: The RLC oracles validate the R-L-C calculation only (peak -> V0/Z0 and V0/R; action -> E/R). They do not validate the translation of that calculation into Mersen's qualification conditions.
single_most_important_missing_input: The internal discharge loop's high-current R and L at the fault (U10/U9 failed-short residual, bank ESR at the discharge frequency, fuse resistance, layout). It decides which of the 400 envelope cells the real discharge occupies, and therefore whether the (nonempty) qualifying region actually contains the fault. Paired second input: a DC/capacitor-discharge let-through I2t for A70QS50-14F and a sourced bank/PCB-copper withstand I2t, without which even a located qualifying cell is not a demonstrated coordination.
next_discriminating_observation: Measure or defensibly model the internal discharge loop R and L (one high-current pulse test, or documented short-residual + ESR + layout), then locate the operating cell in the mapped region; then obtain the A70QS capacitor-discharge let-through and the bank/copper withstand I2t.
